abstract_sentences.text: We propose Stable Video Infinity (SVI) that can generate non-looping, ultra-long videos with stable visual quality, while supporting per-clip prompt control and multi-modal conditioning.

While existing long-video methods attempt to mitigate accumulated errors via handcrafted anti-drifting (e.g., modified noise scheduler, frame anchoring), they remain limited to single-prompt extrapolation, producing homogeneous scenes with repetitive motions.

We identify that the fundamental challenge extends beyond error accumulation to a critical discrepancy between the training assumption (seeing clean data) and the test-time autoregressive reality (conditioning on self-generated, error-prone outputs).

evidence.anchor: discrepancy between the training assumption and the test-time autoregressive reality

abstract_sentences.text: To bridge this hypothesis gap, SVI incorporates Error-Recycling Fine-Tuning, a new type of efficient training that recycles the Diffusion Transformer (DiT)’s self-generated errors into supervisory prompts, thereby encouraging DiT to actively identify and correct its own errors.

evidence.anchor: recycles self-generated errors into supervisory prompts

abstract_sentences.text: This is achieved by injecting, collecting, and banking errors through closed-loop recycling, autoregressively learning from error-injected feedback.

Specifically, we (i) inject historical errors made by DiT to intervene on clean inputs, simulating error-accumulated trajectories in flow matching; (ii) efficiently approximate predictions with one-step bidirectional integration and calculate errors with residuals; (iii) dynamically bank errors into replay memory across discretized timesteps, which are resampled for new input.
SVI is able to scale videos from seconds to infinite durations with no additional inference cost, while remaining compatible with diverse conditions (e.g., audio, skeleton, and text streams).
We evaluate SVI on three benchmarks, including consistent, creative, and conditional settings, thoroughly verifying its versatility and state-of-the-art role.

introduction_moves.previous_problem: 长视频生成的现实需求尚未被限定。
introduction_moves.current_answer: 扩大模型和数据带来 realistic、temporally coherent short videos，但典型长度约 5 秒。
introduction_moves.next_hook: 漂移为何出现以及既有方案如何处理？

introduction_moves.previous_problem: 短长度的根因是 error accumulation，但可用的处理方案尚未分类。
introduction_moves.current_answer: 归纳 noise modification、frame anchoring、improved sampling 三趋势。
introduction_moves.next_hook: 这些方案是否真的校正了累积误差？

introduction_moves.previous_problem: 三种趋势的共同效果仍未说明。
introduction_moves.current_answer: 既有方法只 alleviate 而非 correct，通常只能延长至 10 秒到约 1 分钟，并保留 single-prompt homogeneity。

evidence.anchor: constrained length and the scene homogeneity bias

introduction_moves.previous_problem: 根因应如何被重新表述？
introduction_moves.current_answer: 把 blur/color shift 与 restoration 对齐，同时提出大 DiT 仍快速 collapse 的反常现象。
introduction_moves.next_hook: 训练与测试的假设是否不同？

evidence.anchor: treat the cause rather than the symptom

introduction_moves.previous_problem: 强大的 DiT 为何不自动恢复？
introduction_moves.current_answer: 训练 flow matching 假设 clean trajectory，测试把 predictive error 带入下一 clip；restoration DiT 则两侧都见 injected input。
introduction_moves.next_hook: 用 error feedback bridge hypothesis gap。

evidence.anchor: hypothesis gap between the training and test

introduction_moves.previous_problem: 如何把 self-error 变成学习信号？
introduction_moves.current_answer: ERFT 注入历史 error、用单步双向积分估计、按 timestep replay，并强调 data light/efficient/versatile。
introduction_moves.next_hook: 贡献列表具体化理论、模型家族和 benchmark。

evidence.anchor: injecting historical errors and selectively resample errors

introduction_moves.previous_problem: 方法 preview 尚未列出可检验对象和边界。
introduction_moves.current_answer: 五项贡献覆盖 infinite length、two error types、ERFT、talking/dancing family 和三类 benchmark。
introduction_moves.next_hook: 进入相关工作和形式化 preliminaries。

final_judgment.single_storyline: 将 autoregressive long-video drift 诊断为 clean-training/error-included-test 的 hypothesis gap及其 predictive/conditional 两类误差，再用 ERFT 的 error injection、bidirectional curation、timestep replay 和 LoRA loss 让 DiT 主动校正 self-error；Table 1–4、Fig.5–9 连接 generic、creative、conditional generation。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 gap 定义、两类 error、Eq. (1)–(6)、Fig.3/4 闭环、三 benchmark、Table 1–4、Fig.5/6 和 15-minute/identity qualitative claims，这些内容承担核心决策。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: prompt engine、sample composition、training data、GH200/LoRA hyperparameters、metric attacks、online injection、额外 qualitative cases、style/real-time/identity limitations 和 ethics 移入 Appendix A–E；正文理解方法足够，但复现和边界判断依赖附录。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Fig.2 的 hypothesis-gap diagnosis → Fig.3 的 closed loop → Eq. (3)–(6) 的统一 error objects → Table 4 的 Eimg ablation → Table 1–3 的 duration/condition results，是最有效的机制到结果写作结构。
final_judgment.largest_gap: infinite、no additional inference cost、state-of-the-art 的措辞强于证据：最长明确案例是 15 分钟，缺少 failure rate、uncertainty、seed、task denominator、compute parity；creative prompt-stream L 还存在附录冲突。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 先把训练/测试输入假设写成可计算状态转移，区分 model-induced errors 与 handcrafted corruption，再用同一 error object 完成 injection、replay、component deletion 和 long-horizon evaluation；宣称无限时必须给可失败的 horizon protocol 与长期统计。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 适合以 autoregressive feedback 为根因的 latent/video 或类似生成系统；本文只验证 Wan2.1 I2V、有限数据、VBench++/VBench 指标与 15-minute qualitative horizon，不能直接外推到 streaming real-time、identity guarantee、LLM/MLLM 或无界时长。

evidence_coverage.coverage_method: 逐项检查 abstract、moves、method/theory、visuals、design/results/ablation、claims、appendix、limitations 和 final judgment 的 evidence page/section/anchor/basis。
